check_compressed_tensors_installed: check if the compressed-tensors package is installed and available for import
check_compressed_tensors_raise_error: check if compressed-tensors is installed and raise an ImportError if it is missing
initialize_quantization_with_scheme: initialize a quantization config using a preset scheme string like mxfp4 for Linear layers
initialize_quantization_with_config_grou: initialize a quantization config using explicit config_groups with custom QuantizationScheme objects
initialize_quantization_with_kv_cache: initialize a quantization config with a custom kv_cache_scheme and ignore list for lm_head
